name: Rabbit Trail
source:
Up and attem, René! The citizens of these woods are waiting on their mail and it's up to you to deliver. Just make sure you don't waste any time, a blizzard is set to be rolling in later tonight.

Play as René, an eager mail carrier who works in his family's postal business. Navigate the day as you decide whether it's more important to be productive and uphold your family's expectations, or to pursue what makes you happy.

[From [url=https://mollipop.itch.io/rabbittrail]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
打起精神开工啦，勒内！这片森林里的居民们正翘首期盼着信件送达，投递的重任就全靠你了。不过千万别耽搁时间——今晚稍晚些时候，一场暴风雪就要席卷而来了。

你将扮演在家族邮政行当里干劲十足的邮差勒内。度过这一天的送件旅程，在脚踏实地完成工作、不负家族厚望，与追寻真正令自己快乐的事物之间做出抉择吧。

[摘自[url=https://mollipop.itch.io/rabbittrail]itch.io[/url]]
